title: fix(sharing): a predicate update or delete also writes the rows an app-authored update or delete policy admits
body:
Fixes #37535

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：业务用户按条件批量改或删记录时（流程里的批量节点、脚本），应用自己写的“满足条件可改 / 可删”规则现在也生效；以前单条能改四条、批量只改两条且不报错，现在批量和单条改的是同一批记录。
- 为什么做：这是你在“批量改记录时，要不要也认应用自己写的放行规则？”上选的“现在定：批量也认”，属于“按条件批量写的权限判定”专题，让读、写、批量写的结果一致。
- 出错会怎样：碰到的是写了改 / 删放行规则的应用，批量会多改到规则放行的那些记录；没写这类规则的应用、代他人操作的写入都和以前完全一样；有问题可以直接撤回这个改动。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

Ruling record 7190344023 on #35934, option **2a**: the security service gains an optional, filter-shaped answer, and the record sharing middleware ORs it into its bulk write scope.

- **`@objectstack/spec`**: `ISecurityService.getAuthoredRowWriteFilter?(object, operation, context)`, the filter-shaped twin of `checkAuthoredRowWrite`. It is optional, typed on the same `AuthoredRowWriteOperation` (`update` / `delete`), and `undefined` is the answer that widens nothing (absence, abstention, failure).
- **`@objectstack/plugin-security`**: the head of `checkAuthoredRowWrite` (principal, on-behalf-of, sets, the authored `using` pre-check, Layer 0 + Layer 1 compiled with the floor taken out of the sets by provenance) moved, unedited, into one helper, `authoredRowWriteLayers`. The verdict and the new `getAuthoredRowWriteFilter` both read it, so a row matches the filter iff the verdict admits it, and there is a pin for that. The filter is `layer0 AND layer1`, the verdict's probe predicate without its `{ id }` term. It does no read. The member is served on the registered `security` service (`security-plugin-security-service.ts`, which is where the registration lives since cut 11, beside `security-plugin.ts`).
- **`@objectstack/plugin-sharing`**: `SharingSecurityProbe` declares the member. `SharingService.probeAuthoredRowWriteFilter` is a passthrough that answers `null` for an absent service or member, a principal-less or delegated context, a throw (logged once at `warn`), or anything that is not a filter object. The middleware's bulk branch (`sharing-plugin.ts`, after the ADR-0090 D10 delegator intersection) sets `writeFilter = { $or: [writeFilter, authoredScope] }` before the existing `ast.where = composeAnd(...)`. The branch is skipped when the scope is already `null` and for an on-behalf-of write.

Ruled terms, as implemented:

- (i) The bulk scope is sharing scope OR authored scope, then ANDed into the write as today. plugin-security's own layers are untouched.
- (ii) Verb for verb: the operation is the middleware's write class, and the policies are collected per operation.
- (iii) A delegated write is not widened: the middleware, the passthrough and the security helper each abstain on `onBehalfOf`.
- (iv) An absent member, no authored `using` policy, or any failure leaves today's scope.
- (v) The pins moved. See Tests.
- `buildWriteFilter`, `checkEdit` and `checkDelete` are not edited. There is no per-row probe on the bulk path.
- The 2026-08-15 ruling block (no filter-provenance marking on this merge) is intact. The new composition is unmarked, as that block requires.

`content/docs/permissions/rls.mdx`: one paragraph said a policy-admitted row "is not reached" by a predicate write and told authors to write it by id. This change makes that false, so the paragraph now states the widened bulk scope.

## Why

By id, a row an app-authored `using` update or delete policy admits was written (the sharing gate defers to `checkAuthoredRowWrite`). A predicate write left the same row out, silently, with a smaller count. The ruling replaces the 2026-08-08 deferral on #5493 (Q2 = A1) and the #6736 reopen condition, and states the bulk composition semantics that hold required.

## Tests

The premise clause, measured first at `f72f3353` (this branch's base):

- **Premise 10** holds. The relief pin `predicate-write-floor-deferral.test.ts:632-637` expected by id `r1`–`r4` and by predicate `r1`, `r2`.
- **Premise 12** holds. `grep -rn -A8 "rowLevelSecurity" examples packages/apps --include=*.ts | grep -E "operation|using"` finds one authored row policy, the showcase's `select` policy, and no authored update or delete widener. Pull is still zero. The ruling decided it anyway.
- **The PR #7274 probe** is `packages/qa/dogfood/test/bulk-widener-probe.dogfood.test.ts`, the one file PR #7274 added (read off its file list). `git grep 7274` misses it because the file cites `#6736`. Without the fix (ablation below) its MEASURE cases read exactly their old pins: update touches `['n_bob_open']`, and delete leaves `['d_alice_stale_1', 'd_alice_stale_2']`.
- **Named premise: holds.** With the authored scope ORed in, the rows a predicate write changes equal the rows the by-id write admits:
  - on the relief fixture: predicate `r1`–`r4`, by id `r1`–`r4`;
  - on the #7274 fixtures: update touches `n_alice_open_1`, `n_alice_open_2`, `n_bob_open` = `declaredAdmitted`, `affected: 3`; delete removes all 3, `survivors: []`, `affected: 3`;
  - no row changes for a caller who holds no authored `using` policy (ALICE and CAROL under the rep set, ALICE under a check-only policy), and the scope answers `undefined` for them.

Pins moved (term (v)), plus one more:

- `predicate-write-floor-deferral.test.ts`, "the relief only ever adds rows": the predicate expectation moves from `['r1','r2']` to `['r1','r2','r3','r4']`.
- `bulk-widener-probe.dogfood.test.ts`, the two MEASURE cases: update 1 → 3 and delete 1 → 3, held to `declaredAdmitted`. The header is rewritten from "pins the defect" to "pins the fix".
- **Not named by (v)**: `plugin-security/src/operator-id-write-gate-33928.test.ts` pinned the same divergence on a `private` object with a read share. A two-key `{ id, stage }` predicate under `multi: true` "leaves the row" the policy admits. It now writes it, as the by-id write does. See Acceptance notes.

New pins:

- **`predicate-write-floor-deferral.test.ts`**, `[#37535]` describe, real `SecurityPlugin` + `SharingService` middleware over better-sqlite3. Each case is the #35802 three-way comparison: predicate rows = by-id rows = the named set.
  - Widening: ALICE update and delete `r1`–`r4`. BOB update with `r1` closed: `r2`, `r3`, `r4`. CAROL delete with `r2` closed: `r1`, `r3`, `r4`. Tenant wall: an open deal in another org is not written.
  - Verb for verb: an update-only policy widens update (`r1`–`r4`) and not delete (`r1`, `r2`), and the reverse.
  - CONTROLS: no authored policy, check-only policy, and a delegated write (ALICE on behalf of FRANK, both under the wideners, FRANK a plain member so his half keeps a sharing scope) writes `[]` as by id. A spy shows the scope is never asked.
  - Absent member, a rejecting member, and an internal compile failure all leave `r1`, `r2` or answer `undefined`.
  - One answer: over a mixed matrix, the scope's rows equal the rows `checkAuthoredRowWrite` admits, for both verbs.
- **`plugin-sharing/src/authored-row-write-deferral.test.ts`**: the old "the BULK path is untouched" describe is replaced. It pins the exact composed `where` (`{ $and: [pred, { $or: [sharing, authored] }] }`), the delete verb asked as delete, an unchanged scope for a no-policy caller, no call for a delegated write, and unchanged scope for an absent member, a throw (one `warn`), a non-object answer (4 shapes) and no security service.
- **`spec/src/contracts/security-service.test.ts`**: the member is optional (unguarded call is a compile error, `@ts-expect-error`), not listable as required, its operation is `AuthoredRowWriteOperation` (`select` refused), and absence is `undefined`.
- `registered-security-service-members.pin.test.ts` lists the member (its typecheck reds until it does). The two plugin-sharing middleware doubles (`lifecycle-verb-write-gate`, `operator-id-write-gate-33928`) serve `probeAuthoredRowWriteFilter: async () => null`.

Red without the fix (ablations, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` with a `dist/` preflight, restore proven by blob hash and a rebuilt clean `dist/`):

- **A**: the middleware's OR line replaced by a never-true guard. 8 widening pins in `predicate-write-floor-deferral.test.ts` go red (relief pin, 4 widening, 2 verb-for-verb, tenant wall) and so does the composition pin in `authored-row-write-deferral.test.ts`. All controls stay green. Against the dogfood probe: both MEASURE cases red (`expected [ 'n_bob_open' ]`; 2 survivors), integrity/C1/C2 green. The plugin-security full run at `2d086e65`, before the third pin moved, showed that pin red under the fix in the other direction.
- **B**: the three delegated guards removed. Both delegated controls go red (`expected [ 'r1', 'r2', 'r3', 'r4' ] to deeply equal []`).
- Two first attempts were no-ops and were re-run: a deleted line failed the DTS build, and a `void` marker was dropped by esbuild. The preflight caught the second. Neither counted.

## Acceptance notes

- **Landing point**: as named on the card, plus `security-plugin-security-service.ts`. The `security` service registration lives there since cut 11 and `security-plugin.ts` only hands it the host. `sharing-service.test.ts` gets no new case: the passthrough is pinned in `authored-row-write-deferral.test.ts`, the existing harness for its by-id twin (AGENTS.md: a new pin for a component with a shared harness goes into that file).
- **A third pin moved** beyond (v)'s two: plugin-security's `operator-id-write-gate-33928.test.ts`. Its expectation was the divergence the ruling removes, on a `private` object with a read share. Which branch each shape takes is still pinned against the engine's dispatch decision in plugin-sharing's file of the same name.
- **Member name** `getAuthoredRowWriteFilter`, on the precedent of `getReadFilter` (filter-shaped, `undefined` = no answer) and `checkAuthoredRowWrite` (the same question as a verdict). It is open to the veto window.
- Where the sharing scope is already `null` (org write depth, public objects, no owner field) the authored scope is not asked. There is nothing to widen.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/predicate-write-floor-deferral.test.ts`. Expect 109 passed, including the `[#37535]` describe.

Read first, by risk:

1. `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/sharing-plugin.ts`, the bulk branch: the new `if (writeFilter && !exec?.onBehalfOf?.userId)` hunk.
2. `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin-authored-row-write.ts`: `authoredRowWriteLayers` (moved head) and `getAuthoredRowWriteFilter`.
3. `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/sharing-service.ts`: `probeAuthoredRowWriteFilter`.

Readings, head `c2c17a47` (this branch merged with `origin/main` at `8e3980a9`; the merge touches none of this diff's sources):

<details><summary>Package suites and typecheck</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security test` at `ace203aa` (the last code commit before the merge): 290/290 files, 7330 passed, 45 skipped. At `2d086e65`, before `operator-id-write-gate-33928.test.ts` moved, 2 failed there: its two pins of the old divergence.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-sharing test` at `2d086e65`: 78/78 files, 1754 passed, 11 skipped. Before the two middleware doubles were completed, 25 failed with `service.probeAuthoredRowWriteFilter is not a function`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security typecheck`: exit 0. Before `registered-security-service-members.pin.test.ts` listed the member, 1 error, which is that pin doing its job. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-sharing typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: all 14 generated artifacts up to date.
- On `c2c17a47`, focused: plugin-security 3 files / 115 tests, plugin-sharing 3 / 76, spec contract 1 / 32, dogfood `bulk-widener-probe` + `authored-row-write-scope` 2 / 17. All green.

</details>

<details><summary>The #7274 probe readings (dogfood, real stack)</summary>

- With the fix: update `declaredAdmitted` = `touched` = `n_alice_open_1, n_alice_open_2, n_bob_open`, `authoredScope: { stage: open }`, `affected: 3`. Delete: `survivors: []`, `affected: 3`.
- Ablation A: update `touched` = `n_bob_open` only, and delete keeps the two Alice rows. These are the pins as they stood on main.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gate families</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 119 families. All run on `c2c17a47`, and `--ran` reconciles 119 derived, 118 run, 1 NOT MEASURED, 0 unrun.
- NOT MEASURED: `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` exits 3 (its positive control is pinned to a commit this shallow clone cannot reach). CI runs it on a full checkout.
- Three families first read red only because the merge left stale state (a pre-merge `lint` dist; `pnpm install` not yet re-run for a dependency `service-knowledge` gained; a CLI build behind it): `check:docs-transcript-drift`, `check:i18n`, `check:type-check-debt`. Each was green after the refresh AGENTS.md § 9 orders, re-run on the same head.
- Local-only `check:dev-prereqs`: exit 1, "35 of 110 workspace packages … not on disk". This worktree built only this diff's closures; it is a reading of the local tree, not of the diff.

</details>

Dogfood battery: not owed (no `!` in the title and no narrowing arm). `Test Core`, `Lint & Repo Gates` and the rest run in CI.
